info.name: AiFace Device MQTT API
info.description:
AiFace facial recognition device MQTT/MQTTS communication protocol.

## How to Use
1. Edit the Collection Variables: set `broker_url` to your MQTT broker address (e.g. `mqtt://192.168.1.100:1883`).
2. Set `device_sn` to your device serial number.
3. Open any request folder, click the request, then click **Connect**.
4. Once connected, click **Send** to publish the command to the device.

## Topic Convention
- Server publishes commands TO device on: `aiface/<sn>/pub`
- Device publishes data TO server on: `aiface/<sn>/sub`

## Variables
- `broker_url` — MQTT broker URL, e.g. `mqtt://192.168.1.100:1883`
- `device_sn` — Device serial number, e.g. `LF00000001`
- `enrollid` — Sample user ID used in user management requests

variable.description:
MQTT Broker URL. Change this to your broker address. Examples:
  mqtt://192.168.1.100:1883
  mqtts://192.168.1.100:8883
Device serial number — must match the SN of the target AiFace device
Sample user / enrollment ID used in user management requests
Topic on which the SERVER publishes commands TO the device
Topic on which the DEVICE publishes data TO the server

item.name: 4. Device Registration
item.description: Commands related to device registration and re-registration. The device sends reg automatically on MQTT connect.

item.name: 4.1 reg — Device Registration (Device→Server)
item.description:
The device sends this command automatically immediately after the MQTT connection is established.

Publish this to simulate a device registration message.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 4.2 reg — Server Response (Server→Device)
item.description:
Server response to device registration. Publish this to the device command topic.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 4.3 getreg — Get Device Registration Info (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves full device registration and capability information.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5. User Management
item.description: Commands for managing users: add, update, delete, query user profiles and biometric data.

item.name: 5.1 setuserinfo — Set User Info (Server→Device)
item.description:
Downloads and sets user profile information including biometrics.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.2 deleteuser — Delete User (Server→Device)
item.description:
Deletes a user or specific biometric data.

backupnum: 12 or 13 = delete entire user, 50 = face photo, 51 = face feature, 10 = password, 11 = card

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.3 cleanuser — Clear All Users (Server→Device)
item.description:
Deletes all users from the device.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.4 setusername — Batch Set User Names (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets names and verify modes for multiple users at once.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.5 getusername — Get User Name (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves the name for a specific user.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.6 getuserlist — Get User List Paginated (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of user IDs. Use stn=1 to reset pagination.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.7 getuserids — Get All User IDs (Server→Device)
item.description:
Returns all user IDs in a single response (no pagination).

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.8 getunuserdid — Get Next Available User ID (Server→Device)
item.description:
Returns the next available unused user ID.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.9 checkuserid — Check If User ID Exists (Server→Device)
item.description:
Checks if a specific user ID exists on the device.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.10 getuserinfo — Get User Info (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves detailed user profile. Omit backupnum for full profile; include backupnum for raw biometric data.

backupnum: 50=face photo, 51=face feature, 10=password, 11=card, 0-9=fingerprint

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.10b getuserinfo — Get Face Photo (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves face photo (base64 JPG) for a specific user.

backupnum=50 returns face photo data.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.11 getallusers — Get All Users Paginated (Server→Device)
item.description:
Returns all user data in paginated format. Each user may return multiple records (one per biometric type). Use stn=true to start a new query.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.12 adduser — Start Device-Side Enrollment (Server→Device)
item.description:
Initiates user enrollment on the device. Device will capture biometrics locally.

backupnum: 0-9=fingerprint, 10=password, 11=card, 40/41=palm, 50=face

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.12b adduser — Cancel Enrollment (Server→Device)
item.description:
Cancels the current device-side enrollment process.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.13 checkregstatus — Check Enrollment Status (Server→Device)
item.description:
Queries the current enrollment progress on the device.

Response status: 0=waiting, >=0=success (value=backupnum), <0=failure

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.14 canceladduser — Cancel Enrollment (Server→Device)
item.description:
Cancels the current user enrollment process.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.15 enableuser — Enable/Disable User (Server→Device)
item.description:
Enables or disables a user. Set enflag=true to enable, false to disable.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.16 getuserprofile — Get User Custom Profile (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves the custom profile JSON string for a user.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 5.17 setuserprofile — Set User Custom Profile (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets the custom profile JSON string for a user.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 6. Log Management
item.description: Commands for retrieving, filtering, and clearing attendance and access logs.

item.name: 6.1 getnewlog — Get New/Unread Logs (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves new (unread) attendance/access log records with pagination.

Use stn=1 to reset pagination. Set logphoto=1 to include user photos.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 6.2 getalllog — Get All Logs (Server→Device)
item.description:
Retrieves all log records with optional filtering by user and date range.

Date format: YY-MM-DD (e.g. 25-01-01)

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 6.3 cleanlog — Clear All Logs (Server→Device)
item.description:
Deletes all log records from the device.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 6.4 cleanlogphoto — Clear Log Photos (Server→Device)
item.description:
Deletes all photos associated with log records.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7. Device Management
item.description: Commands for reading and setting device parameters, time, system reset, and device state control.

item.name: 7.1 getdevinfo — Get Device Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads all system parameters. Returns all DI_FIRST to DI_END parameters as key-value pairs.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.2 setdevinfo — Set Device Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets one or more system parameters. Adding DI_SERVERIP/DI_SERVERPORT will trigger connection re-establishment.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.3 getdevcap — Get Device Capacity (Server→Device)
item.description:
Returns device storage capacity information for all biometric types.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.4 gettime — Get Device Time (Server→Device)
item.description:
Gets the current device time.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.5 settime — Set Device Time (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets the device time. Provide both cloudtime (string) and nowtime (Unix ms timestamp).

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.6 initsys — Factory Reset (Server→Device)
item.description:
Performs a factory reset: clears all users and logs, restores default settings, backs up WiFi configuration.

WARNING: This will erase all user data!

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.7 initmenu — Reset Menu Settings (Server→Device)
item.description:
Restores default menu settings. Preserves language and backs up WiFi configuration.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.8 cleandatebase — Clear Database (Server→Device)
item.description:
Clears the entire database. Device must be rebooted after this operation.

WARNING: Requires reboot after execution!

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.9 cleanadmin — Clear All Administrators (Server→Device)
item.description:
Removes all administrator privileges from the device.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.10 cleaninactiveuser — Clear Inactive Users (Server→Device)
item.description:
Removes users who have not been active (no attendance records).

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.11 reboot — Reboot Device (Server→Device)
item.description:
Triggers an immediate device reboot. No response is sent — device restarts immediately.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.12 disabledevice — Disable Device Recognition (Server→Device)
item.description:
Pauses all face, card, fingerprint, and palm detection.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.13 enabledevice — Enable Device Recognition (Server→Device)
item.description:
Resumes all face, card, fingerprint, and palm detection.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 7.14 checklive — Heartbeat Check (Server→Device)
item.description:
Server-initiated heartbeat to verify device connectivity. Device responds to confirm it is alive.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8. Access Control
item.description: Commands for door control, lock configuration, and user access parameters.

item.name: 8.1 opendoor — Remote Door Open (Server→Device)
item.description:
Remotely unlocks the door. Optionally sends user ID via Wiegand and displays a message.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.2 lockctrl — Door Lock Control (Server→Device)
item.description:
Controls the door lock state directly.

fuc: 1=unlock/open, 2=lock/close

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.3 getdoorstatus — Get Door Status (Server→Device)
item.description:
Returns the current door sensor status.

doorstatus in response: 0=closed, 1=open

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.4 setdevlock — Set Door Access Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Configures door access control parameters including timing, zones, and Wiegand settings.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.5 getdevlock — Get Door Access Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads the current door access control configuration.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.6 getuserlock — Get User Door Access Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads door access parameters for a specific user.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.7 setuserlock — Batch Set User Access Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets door access time zones and restrictions for multiple users at once.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.8 deleteuserlock — Delete User Access Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Removes door access parameters for a specific user.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 8.9 cleanuserlock — Clear All User Access Parameters (Server→Device)
item.description:
Removes door access time zones and restrictions for all users.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 9. Attendance Management
item.description: Commands for shift schedules, bell times, and holiday configurations.

item.name: 9.1 getshift — Get Shift Schedule (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads the configured shift/roster schedule. Max 8 shifts, each with up to 3 time sections.

Section type: 0=work, 1=rest, 2=overtime

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 9.2 setshift — Set Shift Schedule (Server→Device)
item.description:
Configures the shift/roster schedule.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 9.3 getbelltime — Get Bell Schedule (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads configured bell/doorbell time schedules.

flag is a bitmask where each bit = a day of week (127 = all days)

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 9.4 setbelltime — Set Bell Schedule (Server→Device)
item.description:
Configures bell/doorbell time schedules.

flag: bitmask for days of week (127=all days, 65=Mon+Sun, etc.)

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 9.5 setholiday — Set Holiday Schedule (Server→Device)
item.description:
Configures holiday schedules.

Date format: MM-DD

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 9.6 getholiday — Get Holiday Schedule (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads configured holiday schedule.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 10. Device Active Reports (Device→Server)
item.description:
Commands initiated by the device and sent to the server. The server processes them and sends back a response.

These are device-to-server messages. Use them to simulate device behavior for testing.

item.name: 10.1 sendlog — Device Reports Attendance Logs (Device→Server)
item.description:
Device proactively sends attendance/access log records to the server.

Publish to sub_topic to simulate device sending logs.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 10.2 senduser — Device Reports User Data Change (Device→Server)
item.description:
Device proactively sends user enrollment/modification data when biometrics are enrolled on the device.

Example: face photo upload (backupnum=50)

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 10.3 sendpin — Device Reports PIN Input (Device→Server)
item.description:
Device reports when a user enters a PIN code on the device keypad.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 10.4 sendqrcode — Device Reports QR Code Scan (Device→Server)
item.description:
Device reports when a user scans a QR code.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 10.5 sendgps — Device Reports GPS Location (Device→Server)
item.description:
Device proactively sends GPS location data (requires USB 4G module).

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 10.6 otacheck — OTA Update Check (Device→Server)
item.description:
Device checks if a firmware update is available.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 10.7 otaget — OTA File Download Chunk (Device→Server)
item.description:
Device requests a chunk of the OTA firmware file.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/sub
Direction: Device → Server

item.name: 11. File Management
item.description: Commands for listing, reading, and writing files on the device.

item.name: 11.1 getdir — List Directory Files (Server→Device)
item.description:
Lists files in a specified directory. Path must start with /data/

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 11.2 getfile — Read File (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads the contents of a file and returns it as base64.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 11.3 writefile — Write File (Server→Device)
item.description:
Writes base64-encoded content to a file on the device.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12. Other Commands
item.description: Firmware upgrade, OTA server configuration, screensaver, voice, keypad, biometric verification, department, company, and questionnaire commands.

item.name: 12.1 upgrade — Firmware Upgrade via Server (Server→Device)
item.description:
Uploads firmware upgrade data to the device in chunks.

This is a multi-chunk operation. Send chunk by chunk, incrementing the index each time.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.2 forceota — Force OTA Update (Server→Device)
item.description:
Triggers an immediate OTA update check and download.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.3 setotaserver — Set OTA Server Address (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets the OTA server address.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.4 getotaserver — Get OTA Server Address (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads the configured OTA server address.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.5 setscreensaver — Set Screensaver (Server→Device)
item.description:
Configures the device screensaver with an image.

Set removeall=true to delete all screensavers. Set remove=true to delete a specific file.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.6 setvoice — Set Custom Voice (Server→Device)
item.description:
Uploads and optionally plays a custom WAV voice file.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.7 keypad — Control On-Screen Keypad (Server→Device)
item.description:
Activates or deactivates the on-screen numeric keypad.

on=true to activate, on=false to deactivate

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.8 verify — Biometric Verification (Server→Device)
item.description:
Performs face or fingerprint verification on the server side.

Provide face (base64 JPG) or finger (hex with compression) for verification.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.9 setdepartment — Set Department List (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets the department list on the device. Set delete=true to clear all departments.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.10 getdepartment — Get Department List (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads the configured department list.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.11 setcompanyname — Set Company Name (Server→Device)
item.description:
Sets the company name displayed on the device.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.12 getcompanyname — Get Company Name (Server→Device)
item.description:
Reads the configured company name.

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

item.name: 12.13 setquestionnaire — Set Questionnaire (Server→Device)
item.description:
Configures a questionnaire/survey displayed to users after verification.

Schedule format: HH:MM-HH:MM*N (N = repeat interval in minutes)

Topic: aiface/{{device_sn}}/pub
Direction: Server → Device

body.raw:
{
  "cmd": "setquestionnaire",
  "sn": "{{device_sn}}",
  "title": "Health Declaration",
  "voice": "health.wav",
  "errmsg": "Please complete the survey",
  "radio": true,
  "optionflag": 0,
  "items": ["Option A", "Option B", "Option C"],
  "schedules": ["08:00-18:00*1"],
  "usequestion": true,
  "useschedule": false,
  "card": 0,
  "switch_card": 0,
  "enrollid": 0,
  "open": false
}
